title: Police report no injuries in Sultan Kudarat school incident

blocks.text: GENERAL SANTOS CITY — Police said all students and personnel of Isulan National High School (INHS) in Sultan Kudarat were safe, and no injuries were reported in the incident that caused panic there Wednesday morning. Col. Marvin Fontalva, acting director of the Sultan Kudarat Police Provincial Office (SKPPO), said police personnel were coordinating with the school administration and other authorities as they continue to investigate what really happened in what was reported as an “alleged shooting incident.” “Based on the latest report received by this office, all teachers and students are safe, and no injuries have been reported,” he added.
